title: OpenAI Researchers on the Future of Mathematical Reasoning
content: OpenAI mathematicians Mehtaab Sawhney and Mark Sellke discuss recent AI advancements in mathematical reasoning during an interview with a16z. They highlight model breakthroughs in sphere packing and non-sofic groups, noting that AI reasoning traces increasingly resemble expert human strategies, including problem selection and backtracking. The discussion addresses the implications for the field, suggesting that AI may generate more mathematics than humans can absorb while also making complex results more accessible. This shift may alter the traditional role of human taste and judgment in mathematical discovery.

title: 连OpenAI自己都受不了“AI味”了：GPT-6官方指南出炉，首次成体系封杀大模型烂梗词 | 原文
content: OpenAI has released a new official prompt engineering guide for its GPT-6 Astra model, explicitly prohibiting common "AI-flavored" clichés and repetitive phrases. This initiative addresses the distinctive, often unnatural stylistic patterns users perceive in large language models. By systematically restricting these specific word choices, OpenAI aims to improve the quality and naturalness of model outputs. The guide accompanies the full availability of Astra for Plus and Business subscribers, offering targeted instructions to help developers and users generate more authentic and less formulaic responses.
